description.p: Spela is a native game emulation player that connects to your self-hosted Spela server. Browse your game library, download and play games with libretro-powered emulation, and sync save states across all your devices.

ul.li: Native performance with Vulkan rendering and post-processing shaders
Support for NES, SNES, Game Boy, Genesis, N64, PlayStation, and more
Cloud save state sync across devices
CRT and LCD shaders for authentic retro visuals

description.p: Initial Linux release with AppImage and Flatpak support.
